notes.title: Demo Patch
notes.notes:
Changes:

Small terrain tweaks

Shifted positions of some items

Slight visual changes in the Amber Shore

Small balance tweaks

The game now automatically saves when starting a battle

Bugfixes:

Fixed an issue where certain upgrades caused the game to freeze momentarily and then cause the player to be unable to build anything

Also disabled those upgrades as they should not have been unlocked at this stage

Fixed an issue where the player would be unable to enter other areas if their FPS exceeded 100

Fixed an issue where the player sometimes respawned out of bounds

Other minor bug fixes
